contract: Pure policy over the open ask_person actions of one request: settles an ask with the answer of its named, host-verified person or its recorded outcome (expired is the time-out), refuses wrong-person and incompatible answers, and routes verified text to an answer or a message; ready PatternStep owns shapes and first settlement. No timer, runtime or authentication.
limits: No process, clock, timer, deadline arithmetic, storage, callback, authentication or recording; the engine records expired for an ask past its deadline before later inputs.
Not an approval: no approval state and no binding of an exact action; a text never settles an ask by itself.
Selected Cure law covers supplied classifications only; map validation, text comparison, ask lookup and the ready tracker are finite-test or upstream grounded.
Phase, open waits, pause and continue stay with workflow/bot-run-lifecycle; Attempt currentness stays with workflow/run; inputs must be of the current Attempt.

grounding.claim: For both values of the ask-lookup flag and each tracker settlement class, a person answer whose three person texts are not all equal is never the answer decision; excludes map validation, text comparison, lookup and the ready tracker.
Pinned Cure checks types and totality of the production decision; the source audit reports no axiom, hole, unresolved, unaudited, opaque or unproved-total definition and zero absurd.

Named groups answer_after_timeout_is_late, other_person_refused, first_answer_stands, answer_names_its_ask and text_without_open_ask_is_message, redacted invalid operands, the Cure law/audit and the checked example pass; removing the person comparison makes other_person_refused fail (negative control). Finite scenarios, not an authentication proof.
Pinned Cure compilation, reduction checking and BEAM decision semantics; compiler soundness not locally proved.
Pinned Elixir immutable maps and exact binary equality; ready PatternStep decode/encode/accept settlement is reused unchanged.

The host authenticates the sender and supplies a truthful verified_person, names the person of each ask from trusted data, records each input before the policy reads it, gives only current-Attempt inputs, records expired for an ask past its deadline before any later input, and serializes and preserves state and tracker.

telemetry.contract: Pure callable emits no observations; the host owns instrumentation.

config.contract: No selectable behavior: asks, tracker and verified identity are recorded data operands, and the 0..64 ask bound is fixed.

control.contract: No independently controlled runtime or lifecycle commands.
